changelog:
Initial release of customer-outage-notice skill:

- Generates clear customer-facing outage and service-disruption notifications across all incident phases.
- Produces status-page updates (investigating → identified → monitoring → resolved), customer emails, in-app banners, and resolved/post-incident summaries.
- Uses plain, reassuring language, focusing on scope, status, timing, and actionable info.
- Promotes honest, timely communication and includes best-practice quality checks and anti-pattern guidance.
